name: Caoimhe

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text:
Caoimhe is an Irish heroine.
Her other names are Keeva and Keeva of the White Skin.
She is the daughter of Fionn Mac Cumhaill.
Fionn is the great hero of Irish legend.
Caoimhe does not hold a central place in the tales.
Her link rests on one bond: she married Goll Mac Morna.
Goll was an enemy of Fionn.

okr.objective: Caoimhe is an Irish heroine and the daughter of Fionn Mac Cumhaill.
